如果滤网已经正确安装，再对照引用中的图片检查指定位置是否有磁铁。请先确认滤网的安装状态。
entries.answer_en:

https://d3pkbgk01oouhl.cloudfront.net/upload_file/prod/install-the-filter.png

2. If the filter is installed correctly, further check whether there is a magnet in the position shown in the picture.

entries.answer_zh:
7031 表示返回基站失败。
先检查并清理基站周围妨碍回充的障碍物，确认周围空间足够。
如果仍无法回充，再核对基站是否放在地毯上，并检查万向轮是否缠绕毛发。后续轮胎清洁方式请按引用步骤进行。
entries.answer_en:
* 1.The robot is blocked by obstacles during the process of getting on the seat, so it cannot enter the station. Please check and clear the obstacles around the station to ensure that there is enough space around the station.

https://d3pkbgk01oouhl.cloudfront.net/upload_file/prod/Ensure-adequate-space-around-the-base-station.png

* 2.It is recommended not to place the station on the carpet. The robot is more likely to slip or be blocked when it moves backwards on the carpet.
* 3.Please check whether the robot's swivel wheel is seriously entangled with hair. This may make it difficult for the robot to get onto the station. Please clean the hair on the swivel wheel and try again.
https://d3pkbgk01oouhl.cloudfront.net/upload_file/prod/Check-robot-swivel-wheel-for-heavy-hair-entanglement.png
https://d3pkbgk01oouhl.cloudfront.net/upload_file/prod/How-to-clean-robot-swivel-wheel.mov

4. Check the surface and grooves of the robot's left and right wheels for sand, gravel, or oil stains. If there are, wipe them clean with a dry or slightly damp cloth. After cleaning, manually return the robot to the base station.

entries.answer_zh:
先检查基站是否通电、背部电源线是否插紧，必要时换一个插座。
将机器人开关拨到 O，等 3–5 秒再拨到 I，等待约 30 秒。随后放回基站并推到底，确认充电触点干净且接触到位。
若能够开机，待电量超过 30% 再尝试清扫；仍无反应，请反馈基站指示灯状态。
entries.answer_en:
1. Verify whether the base station is powered on, and whether the indicator lights on the screen and inside the water tank are illuminating correctly;

2. If the base station is not powered on, try different power sockets to determine whether the base station can be switched on.

3. Inspect the power cable at the rear of the base station to ensure it is securely connected; a loose connection may prevent the base station from receiving power.

https://d3pkbgk01oouhl.cloudfront.net/upload_file/prod/Base-station-power-cable.png

4. If the base station is powered on, move power switch on the robot to the "O" position, pause for 3--5 seconds, then move it to the "I" position. Wait approximately 30 seconds to observe whether the robot powers on correctly. Return the robot to the base station and push it fully back (ensuring the robot makes contact with the base station's charging pins). Verify the charging pins are free of debris, wait 30 seconds, and observe whether the robot can powers on correctly.

https://d3pkbgk01oouhl.cloudfront.net/upload_file/prod/robot-pin.png

https://d3pkbgk01oouhl.cloudfront.net/upload_file/prod/station-pin.png

https://d3pkbgk01oouhl.cloudfront.net/upload_file/prod/robot-pin-contact-with-station-pin-properly.png

5. If the robot powers on correctly on the base station, observe whether it pairs properly with the base station. If the base station displays that the robot is not paired with the base station, please follow the link below to troubleshoot:

https://support.eufy.com/s/article/How-do-I-pair-eufy-S1-Pro-robot-vacuum-cleaner-with-the-base-station

6. If the robot can be powered on, after it starts up, use the app to check whether the battery level exceeds 30%. Once the battery level is above 30%, you can start cleaning and see if it works normally.

先长按电源键 12 秒重置。
确认吸奶器和充电盒都有电，调整吸奶器在盒内的位置；也可以改用磁吸充电线直接充电。充电后仍无法开机，请联系售后检查。
entries.answer_en:
If eufy Wearable Breast Pump S1 Pro(T8D04) fails to power on: 
1. Press and hold the power button for 12 seconds to reset and check if it powers on. 
2. Try a different charging position in the charging case. 
3. Ensure the pump and charging case are both charged before use. 
4. Try charging directly with the magnetic charging cable instead of the case. 
5. If the issue persists after charging, contact eufy customer support.

先确认充电盒本身有电。将泵体充电触点对准盒内磁吸接口，放好后应听到咔嗒声、看到白色充电灯闪烁。

entries.answer_en:
If eufy Wearable Breast Pump S1 Pro(T8D04) is not charging in the charging case: 
1. Check the charging connection: Align the charging pins on the pump hub with the magnetic charging port inside the case. You should hear a click and see the charging indicator light flash white. 
2. Clean the magnetic charging contacts on both the pump and inside the case with a dry cloth. 
3. Ensure the charging case itself has sufficient charge --- charge the case first if needed. 
4. Try repositioning the pump hub in the slot.

entries.answer_zh:
先检查鸭嘴阀和隔膜是否有裂缝、缺口或破损；如有损坏，请停止使用该配件并更换。
检查鸭嘴阀、法兰通道、隔膜和主机是否装好并密封，佩戴处不要留空隙。
再检查电量，低电量可能导致吸力下降。请告诉我检查后是吸力偏弱，还是完全没有吸力。
entries.answer_en:
1. Inspect the duckbill valve and diaphragm for damage (cracks, chips, holes, or tears). If damaged, discontinue use and replace. 
2. Check that the assembly is correct --- ensure the four components (duckbill valve, flange tunnel, diaphragm, pump hub) are perfectly sealed. 
3. Ensure the flange is properly sealed against your breast with no air gaps. 
4. Check the battery level --- low battery may reduce suction performance.

entries.answer_zh:
先清洁尘盒滤网、滚刷和滚刷护罩梳齿，再启动一次清扫。
检查清洁配件是否损坏或老化，必要时更换。若仍吸不干净，请提供未清洁区域的照片或视频，方便进一步判断。

It's also recommended to provide pictures or videos of the areas that have not been cleaned well so that we can provide a more accurate solution.



You can clean and maintain the accessories according to the video link below.

https://d3pkbgk01oouhl.cloudfront.net/upload_file/prod/How-to-clean-the-dust-box-of-the-X10-Pro-Omni-T2351.mov

https://d3pkbgk01oouhl.cloudfront.net/upload_file/prod/How-to-clean-the-comb-teeth-of-the-X10-Pro-Omni-T2351.mp4



Tips: When the roller brush guard's scraper or roller brush, filter and other cleaning accessories reach the end of their service life or become damaged or aged, please replace the accessories in time to maintain the normal cleaning effect of the robot;

https://d3pkbgk01oouhl.cloudfront.net/upload_file/prod/Damaged-scraper-strip-of-the-roller-brush-guard.jfif

该资料建议将 eufy Clean App 更新到 3.9.2 或以上，再长按电源键重启机器人并重新连接。也可以用手机热点测试网络连接。
entries.answer_en:
Software troubleshooting for Wi-Fi connection issues with the Omni E28:

1. Update your eufy Clean app to version 3.9.2 or above
After updating, press and hold the power button to restart your robot, then try to connect to the network again.

2. Confirm your network type is 2.4GHz
The robot can only connect to 2.4GHz Wi-Fi networks. If your home network is set to 5GHz, switch it to 2.4GHz and try again.

3. Verify your Wi-Fi password is correct
Copy the password directly from your phone's Wi-Fi settings, or try connecting the robot to a hotspot created by your phone to check if it connects smoothly.

4. Check your home network environment
Keep the robot, router, and phone close to each other to ensure the Wi-Fi signal is strong enough for a stable connection.

entries.answer_zh:
E25 支持 2.4GHz Wi-Fi，请先核对频段和密码，并把机器人、路由器和手机靠近。
若仍离线，同时按住电源键和回充键 3 秒，听到网络重置提示后重新配网。还可换一部手机尝试。
entries.answer_en:
Basic troubleshooting steps
1. Confirm basic connection information
- Confirm the networking steps are correct and the entered Wi-Fi password is accurate; suggest the customer copy the password from the phone's Wi-Fi settings, or connect the robot to a phone hotspot to test connectivity.
- Confirm the network type: E25 supports only 2.4GHz Wi-Fi. If the home network is 5GHz, switch to 2.4GHz and retry.

2. Optimize the network environment
Keep the robot, router, and phone close together to maintain sufficient Wi-Fi signal strength.

3. Reset Wi-Fi settings
Press and hold the robot's power button + recharge button for 3 seconds; when you hear "Network reset, re-pairing", the reset is successful. Retry pairing after reset.

4. Rule out device compatibility issues
Try pairing with another phone to rule out compatibility issues with the original phone.

Follow-up
If the issue persists, have customer service collect the user account, machine ID, and the time the abnormality occurred, and submit to the PDP team to pull backend data for remote analysis.

entries.answer_zh:
X10 Pro Omni 支持 2.4GHz Wi-Fi，不支持 5GHz。
请在路由器中开启 2.4GHz 网络，然后让机器人连接该网络；双频路由器可同时保留原有 5GHz 网络。
entries.answer_en:
Troubleshooting steps for eufy Clean X10 Pro Omni(T2351) when it cannot connect to WiFi after switching to 5GHz: 
The X10 Pro Omni only supports 2.4GHz WiFi networks and does not support 5GHz as a hardware limitation. 
1. Enable the dual-band function on your router. Most mainstream dual-band routers support running 2.4GHz and 5GHz WiFi networks simultaneously. Turn on the 2.4GHz band in router settings while keeping the existing 5GHz band unchanged. 
2. Connect the robot to the newly enabled 2.4GHz WiFi network. 
If a dual-band router is not available, consider using a different 2.4GHz access point or Wi-Fi extender.

entries.answer_zh:

把基站尽量靠近路由器，避开墙体遮挡和信号盲区。若仍无法连接，请保留配网录屏和路由器型号供售后核查。

entries.answer_en:
If eufy Wearable Breast Pump S1 Pro(T8D04) cannot reconnect to the Anker eufy app: 
1. Ensure Bluetooth is enabled on your phone and the app has Bluetooth permissions. 
2. Restart the pump and force close the app, then reopen and try again. 
3. For Android: Add the app to the battery whitelist to prevent background killing. 
4. If the issue persists, remove the pump from the app and re-add it.

entries.answer_zh:
重新检查法兰外圈是否完全密封、鸭嘴阀是否破损。
佩戴时保持乳头位于法兰通道中央，使用包覆良好的哺乳文胸帮助贴合。结束后先让法兰侧朝上，再取下容器。
entries.answer_en:
eufy Wearable Breast Pump S1 Pro(T8D04) is designed with double seal and a strengthened lower half of the flange for leak protection. To prevent leaking: 
1. After assembling, check again that the outer ring of the flange is perfectly sealed. 
2. Make sure your nipple is at the center of the flange tunnel and use a full-coverage nursing bra to create a tight seal. 
3. When finishing pumping, hold the container with the flange side facing up before removing from the breast. 
4. Check the duckbill valve for damage --- a cracked valve is a common cause of leaking.

entries.answer_zh: 可水洗配件可以放进洗碗机，但仅限上层。电机主机不可以放入洗碗机。
entries.answer_en:
Yes, the washable parts of eufy Wearable Breast Pump S1 Pro(T8D04) are dishwasher-safe, but top rack only.

Yes, the washable parts of the S1 Pro breast pump are dishwasher safe, but they should only be placed on the top shelf. The motor, however, is not.

entries.answer_zh: 不要使用微波炉消毒配件。资料说明，这会使塑料配件变形并造成永久损坏。
entries.answer_en: No, do not use a microwave to sterilize eufy Wearable Breast Pump S1 Pro(T8D04) parts. Microwaving will warp the plastic components, causing permanent damage.

entries.answer_en: No, SoloCam S340(T8170) does not support 24/7 continuous recording. It uses event-triggered recording to preserve battery life.

entries.answer_zh:
请尝试更换充电线和适配器，使用原装 5V/2A 线材及适配器，并确认充电环境为 0–45°C。
如果通过 HomeBase 充电，请使用背面的第一个 USB 接口。
entries.answer_en:
If SoloCam S340(T8170) is not charging or not fully charging via USB-C: 
1. Ensure you are using the first USB port on the back of the HomeBase (if charging via HomeBase). 
2. Confirm if the issue persists with a different cable and adapter. 
3. Check the charging temperature: must be between 0°C (32°F) and 45°C (113°F). 
4. Use the original 5V/2A cable and adapter.

entries.answer_zh:
检查太阳能板与摄像头的线缆是否插紧、完好，安装位置是否无遮挡且每天有数小时直射阳光；充电温度应在 0–45°C。
在 App 的电源管理中检查电源模式设置。若插座充电正常而太阳能不充电，可用另一块兼容太阳能板交叉测试。
entries.answer_en:
Troubleshooting steps for eufy SoloCam S340 when it is not charging via the solar panel:

1. Environment and connection check. Ensure the cable between the solar panel and camera is firmly plugged in and not damaged. Confirm the solar panel installation is unobstructed and receives several hours of direct sunlight daily. The charging temperature must be within 0-45 degrees Celsius.

2. Mode check. Open the Anker eufy app, go to My Device > Camera > Camera Settings > Power Management > Power Source, and confirm the mode is correctly set.

3. Cross-verify. Since the device charges via a charger socket but not via solar, the solar panel or its connection may be faulty. Test with another compatible solar panel if available.

If the issue persists, provide the device SN, mobile phone model, and a photo of the device installation to customer support for further analysis.

entries.answer_zh:
先检查电量，电量过低时先充电。按一下 SYNC 键，若指示灯不亮，可长按 2 秒开机。
将摄像头移近路由器，并确认有独立的 2.4GHz 网络。仍离线时，在 App 中移除摄像头后重新添加。
entries.answer_en:
1. Check the camera battery level. If too low, charge it.

2. Press and release the SYNC button. If LED is off, press and hold 2 seconds to power on.

3. If recently relocated, move closer to the router.

4. Remove the offline camera from the app and re-add it.

* Check if your home network is set up as a dual-band network. You need to separate a 2.4GHz band for your devices to connect to. If you have multiple devices, you can use cross-location verification to eliminate the interference of location on device stability.

把机器人放到基站外，按回充键，观察能否回站并充电。清扫期间不要关闭或移动基站，并保持回站路径上的门打开。
entries.answer_en: 1.Check if the base station is properly powered on and the white ring-shaped light is illuminated. 2.Place the robot cleaner outside the base station and press the recharge button. If the robot successfully docks and charges, the hardware is functioning normally. If it fails to return, we will further assist you. tips： 1.Do not power off or relocate the base station during the robot's cleaning cycle. 2.Keep doors along the return path to the base station open to prevent the robot from being unable to locate its position.
